_comment: A PROJECT layer, for the requests in this folder and below. The stages are spelled the same as every other project's -- that is what makes one Ctrl+E move the whole app between them -- and only the values differ. Anything not named here falls through to storage/env.json, so team is written once at the root rather than four times here. Alt+E on any request in this folder opens this file. It is not listed as a request: env.json is skipped by the requests tab.
